parameters.query:
SELECT
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(m), '[]') FROM (
     SELECT category, content FROM emma_memory ORDER BY importance DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT 20) m) AS memory,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]') FROM (
     SELECT id, title FROM emma_tasks WHERE status = 'open' ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 10) t) AS tasks,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(c ORDER BY c.created_at), '[]') FROM (
     SELECT mode, left(thoughts, 400) AS thoughts, created_at FROM emma_cycles ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 2) c) AS emma_thoughts,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(d ORDER BY d.created_at), '[]') FROM (
     SELECT from_agent, to_agent, left(message, 300) AS message, created_at FROM agent_dialogue
     WHERE from_agent = 'JARVIS' OR to_agent = 'JARVIS' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 6) d) AS dialogue;
